text:
Maria: quick sync — planning a microsurge to lift activation tied to next webinar + free credits. thinking 3 arms: A) instant starter credits at signup, B) gated credits unlocked after watch, C) no credits but prebuilt prompt templates + onboarding nudge. primary metric = % who complete first meaningful generation within 72h. target lift: +8–12%. :seedling:

Devon: sounds good. can we scope audience? new signups last 14d or only webinar registrants? also what’s the baseline activation rate? :eyes:

Maria: baseline for new signups is ~18% 72h activation. target cohorts: new signups with utm_campaign=webinar-q2 OR webinar registrants who signed in within 7d. sample size calc I ran says ~4k per arm for detectable lift.

Anya: for arm C (templates) I can ship 6 starter prompt packs: 
- product-ideas
- customer-support-bot
- docs-summarizer
- email-drafts
- code-refactor
- seo-meta
Each pack = 3 prompts + micro-tips. I also propose an inline "run these 3" checklist in onboarding.

Sam: routing note — inbound registrants should hit a different onboarding route. I'll add a flag in the signup event: onboarding_flow=webinar_experiment. We can route to variant via AB test key. If no activation after 48h, trigger an SDR ping (only for gated-credit arm failures). I’ll share the webhook mapping.

Ben: webinar narrative idea — benchmark case studies that show latency + cost tradeoffs. Example headline: "Ship chat features at 10% of current per-message cost" and include a short demo using our batching + caching. That makes credits feel like a way to try cost-savings not just free tokens. :rocket:

Maria: love that. also can we add a short in-webinar CTA that unlocks gated credits immediately if they click and complete a 2-min flow? that might blur arms but increases signal for intent.

Devon: ok but track attribution carefully — add event: gated_credit_unlocked_via_webinar. also log prompt_pack_used and first_success=true/false. need these for funnel attribution.

Anya: copy suggestion for the nudge: "Get 50 starter credits — try these 3 prompts and ship a quick demo in minutes." Plus microcopy under each prompt explaining expected output. keeps friction low.

Sam: timeline — builder ready Fri (assets + routes), infra AB keys done Mon, roll pilot to 10% Tue, full roll Fri. I'll add the experiment config here: 
```json
{ "experiment": "webinar_credit_funnel_v1", "arms": ["instant_credit","gated_credit","templates_only"], "variant_key": "onboarding_flow" }
```

Ben: data review cadence? suggest Day 3 signal + Day 7 final. weekly checkpoint w/ ops + product. Also AEs — can we give SDRs a short lead sheet for any gated_credit unlocks that didn't convert after 72h?

Maria: yes — weekly sync Thu 10am. next steps: Anya produce prompt packs + copy, Sam wire routes + AB keys, Devon finalize metrics & sample calc, Ben prepare webinar bench slides. I'll post a one-pager by EOD. :white_check_mark: 

GrowthBot: Reminder — experiment kickoff deadline: 1710006000 (epoch). Please update the #marketing calendar. :calendar:

Devon: noted — will post the measurement doc in the channel and tag @data-team once ready.

Maria: thanks team — small, fast experiment, big signal. keep it tight. :muscle:
